description: Founded in 2013, Geocledian is designing and providing custom crop monitoring solutions based on satellite technology. For this purpose, Geocledian has developed the comprehensive Ag|Knowledge V4 API, a crop monitoring platform providing near real-time analysis ready data, analytics tools and crop modelling with more than 90 different endpoints. It enables users to integrate remote sensing and weather-based crop analytics into end-user applications or workflow management systems with minimum effort and development time. These custom solutions can be tuned to a large variety of crops, cultivation types and regions. They may range from determining optimum harvesting dates for grains, to validating the provenance of a variety of supplied goods to fulfil contract obligations, or is enabling sugar mills to efficiently deal with thousands of small growers fields. Geocledian has built and improved this platform over the last 9 years. It uses open satellite data from Sentinel, Landsat but is also integrating commercial weather data and other datasets. Our Ag|Knowledge product is successfully used by multiple farm management systems, traceability systems and for compliance systems with a customer focus on Europe and Asia.

entityDescription:
Natural Solutions stands at the intersection of data and biodiversity. 
As a data and IT consultancy for biodiversity since 2008, we develop technological solutions to preserve, restore, and reconnect people with nature.
With 16 years of experience specializing in biodiversity data management, we have worked for governments, research centers, natural parks, NGOs, and private companies dealing with all types of biodiversity datasets in various formats, including species occurrences, monitoring protocols, and geospatial data.

Digital Biodiversity
Natural Solutions specializes in designing, developing & implementing advanced technological solutions for biodiversity data management. We are a team of committed engineers with skills in IT for the environment: biodiversity, AI, design, UX, UI, geomatics, web and mobile development, sensor engineering, and so on. This dual expertise means we can accurately translate the customer's needs and propose the best technologies.

Decade of Experience
Since 2008, we have imagined and provided tools for french and international biodiversity stakeholders that enhance the collection, management, analysis, and visualization of biodiversity data. We have extensive experience working with various types of data enabling us to accurately understand and address our client’s needs. Our familiarity with geospatial, occurrence, monitoring and genetics data ensures we can manage it effectively and tailor our solutions to meet your specific requirements.
Prestigious clients
We have worked on various website architecture projects for different stakeholders, including governments, cities, research groups, NGOs, and private companies. Our customers include the French Museum of Natural History, most of French national and regional parks, and several European projects such as the design of the Marine Beacon platform, dedicated to the understanding of how fisheries bycatch impacts protected, endangered and threatened species.

Greenerwave is a French deep-tech startup based in the heart of Paris. Founded in 2016 by CNRS researcher Geoffroy Lerosey and Mathias Fink, professor at ESPCI Paris, to promote their pioneering research into shaping electromagnetic waves using smart materials and deep-physics algorithms.

In 2012, they took the concept of reconfigurable smart surfaces from the field of optics to that of telecommunications, with their first proof-of-concept of an intelligent indoor environment enhanced by a wavefront shaping approach. Since this first technological achievement, Greenerwave has continued its journey in the wireless communications industry. It applies its unique technology and wave control know-how to a wide range of applications, fromRFIDand4D RADAR imagingto steerable electronic antennas forSATCOMand5G-6G.
Using intelligent reconfigurable materials based on cost-effective and off-the-shelf electronic components, and proprietary physical algorithms, Greenerwave shifts complexity from hardware to software.
The products developed are cost-effective and low-consumption, which explains the growing interest of major industry players.

Company description: The IDA (Industrial Development Agency) is a state-owned, join-stock company under ownership supervision of the Chancellery of the Prime Minister of Poland. The IDA supports business enterprises in operation and development of business activity, as well as in the implementation of restructuring processes, and plays a major role in increasing competitiveness of Polish industry. The broad spectrum of support instruments includes both financial products and non-financial assistance in implementation of projects, such as providing access to investment areas and production facilities within Special Economic Zones administered by the IDA. The Company also makes it possible for business partners to liaise in implementing innovative projects. As part of the Polish Development Fund Group, the IDA cooperates with major Polish institutions supporting enterprises and provides comprehensive solutions in response to the current needs and challenges faced by businesses.
Since 2016, IDA has been conducting a dedicated support program for Polish space companies: “Comprehensive support program for Polish space technology sector”. This program defines and divides all IDA activities in four fields:
•Human Resources development;
•New business projects;
•Promotion;
•Financial instruments.
In each defined field IDA has developed support mechanism. Since 2016 each year IDA together with Polish Space Industry Association organises internship program. Up to 15 companies can hire an intern chosen in a contest for six months, IDA covers up to 50% of costs of such internship. During three finished editions, all together 43 young specialist were hired by 21 companies. IDA has also started initiative Space Academy, which main idea is to enable young engineers retrain from other speciality to space technology sector. Using competences of Warsaw University of Technology, Military University of Technology and Space Research Centre Polish Academy of Science training focused on Satellite Integration Phases – 0/A/B/C/D is offered with partial financing of IDA. 
IDA supports national programs dedicated to start-up acceleration, one of them is European Satellite Navigation Competition 2016, Space3ac Acceleration Program 2016 or European Rover Challenge 2018. Recently IDA become partner of MyGalileoApp competition of European Global Navigation Satellite System Agency. Additionally to improve cooperation between Polish large companies and SME’s, IDA provides service in searching and selecting innovative project for large companies in specified fields. Such activity/contest is done together with industrial partners and it’s called ARP Innovation Pitch. Since 2016 we have organised 20 such contests. One of ARP Innovation Pitch was dedicated to space technology.
Activities of IDA related with international promotion are: financial support of national stand on international conferences and trades: Paris Space Week 2016, SpaceTech Expo 2017 (Bremen) or International Astronomical Congress 2018 (Bremen). National promotion is implemented by organising large events: Satellite Forum 2017, European Space TechTransfer Forum 2019 or supporting existing ones: Space Sectore Forum (2016 and 2018). Since 2017 IDA has launched dedicated loan program for polish space companies. One of the financial support mechanisms is the Open Innovation Network project that involves animating and supporting technology transfer transactions to Polish SMEs sector. Enterprises can obtain the grants which refund up to 70% of costs invested in the purchase of innovative technologies. Project is financed form UE founds. IDA is active both Polish space technology sector and generally technology transfer. IDA has dedicated platform for technology transfer between polish companies: Technology Transfer Platform.

Ekitia is a French not-for-profit association whose ambition is to build a framework of trust, ethics and sovereignty, guaranteeing the equitable development of the data and knowledge economy.
Its missions revolve around 3 main areas:
1) Establish the founding principles of trust through the Ekitia Ethical Charter for Data Use(https://www.ekitia.fr/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Ethical-charter-for-data-use-Ekitia.pdf), which is the result of collaborative work carried out under the supervision of a research laboratory, then co-constructed with all Ekitia members and citizens.
2) Accompany and accelerate innovative projects that drive progress, by coordinating and structuring a large community of researchers, administrations and companies in the fields of data and artificial intelligence, and by creating synergies between public and private players on a national, European and international scale.
3) Structure a data economy (general interest and new services) by identifying privacy-enhancing technologies, structuring business models for data sharing and new regulations.

entityDescription: Domenico Capolongo, PhD, is an Associate Professor of Physical Geography and Geomorphology at the University of Bari Aldo Moro, Italy. His research primarily focuses on geomorphological processes and hydrogeological risks, with particular attention to landslides and erosion in rapidly evolving landscapes. He employs advanced GIS and remote sensing techniques, integrating data from field surveys, drones, and satellite imagery with numerical modelling to analyze and predict hazardous processes. Professor Capolongo is involved in the PNRR project RETURN (REducing risks, enhancing ecosystem services, and fostering Resilient communities), which aims at risk reduction and sustainable land management in areas prone to hydrogeological instability. He has an extensive publication record, with numerous research papers and citations highlighting his significant contributions to the study of geomorphological hazards.

entityDescription:
elementarhy GmbH is an innovative green technology startup dedicated to transforming the hydrogen and space economy. Founded on more than 60 years of exceptional scientific research and energy management, the company aims to provide electrochemical energy solutions through the development of Membrane Electrode Assemblies (MEAs) for electrolyzers. The founders, Arne Birth and Dr. Gustav Sievers, recognized the urgent need for energy security and cost efficiency during the European energy crisis in 2022, positioning elementarhy as a leader in the green hydrogen supply chain
The hydrogen market faces significant cost challenges, including the reliance on fossil fuels and producing molecules in space adding the need to meet ambitious decarbonization goals set by governments worldwide. Current green hydrogen production methods involve high costs, reliance on critical raw materials, and limited scalability, creating a gap for more cost efficient and sustainable solutions.
elementarhy's revolutionary technology focuses on the production of cost-efficient and scalable MEAs, which are the key part in terms of performance and costs that generates green hydrogen. By minimizing the use of critical materials like iridium and ensuring high durability and performance, elementarhy's MEAs offer an environmentally friendly way to reduce the costs of hydrogen production up to 25% to scale the hydrogen production with Levelized Costs of Hydrogen (LCOH) below �2/kg.
The global hydrogen market on earth and space is experiencing rapid growth, with over 1,572 projects and an estimated USD 680 billion in investments. The demand for green hydrogen is projected to surge due to environmental concerns, technological advancements, and regulatory incentives and further space relevant applications like satellite thruster, logisitcs and human space exploration. elementarhy is poised to capture a significant share of this expanding market by providing innovative solutions that align with global sustainability targets.
We invite investors, partners, and industry stakeholders to engage with elementarhy to enable our electrolyzer manufacturer customers to provide cost competitive and scalable green hydrogen production and accelerate the transition to a zero-emission society.

entityName: HELMHOLTZ - ZENTRUM FUER UMWELTFORSCHUNG GMBH - UFZ
entityDescription: The UFZ is one of the world’s leading research centres in the field of environmental research, enjoying high social recognition. It demonstrates ways in which a sustainable use of our natural resource base is possible for the benefit of both mankind and the environment. Our Mission: Biodiversity, functioning ecosystems, clean water and intact soils all make up our natural resource base. In the face of global change, employees at the Helmholtz Centre for Environmental Research – UFZ are united by the goal of demonstrating ways to combine societal development with a healthy environment. The UFZ conducts excellent research and takes on a shaping role in the scientific community. As a reliable partner, the UFZ supports the political arena, the economy and the general public to better understand the consequences of human actions on the environment and to develop options for social decision-making processes. For this purpose, the UFZ responds to the stimuli created by society and by producing know-how and technologies that should help to rapidly identify problems comprising conflicting priorities between the environment and society. The UFZ will consequently work on precautionary measures. In dealing with complex environmental issues, the disciplinary borders between the natural-, engineering- and social sciences need to be overcome. The UFZ has extensive competences in integrated environmental research. It boasts innovative scientific infrastructures and nurtures indispensable national and international cooperation, enabling problem-solving at the highest level. The creativity and motivation of UFZ employees, their personal and professional development and the promotion of young scientists all within a positive working environment as well as highly attractive working conditions for leading international researchers are all key factors for the successful promotion of this mission.

entityDescription:
The Amentum company is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. We, as an Amentum branch based in Slovakia, are mainly focused on decommissioning processes and managing radioactive waste in nuclear industry mostly in Europe, providing expertise in decontamination solutions, radiation shielding protection, radiation safety and chemical analysis for nuclear power plants and facilities. By leveraging advanced technologies, strong experience and a deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, Amentum helps clients achieve environmental stewardship and energy sustainability, contributing to a safer, cleaner future while supporting mission-critical operations. We established ourselves as a trusted supplier in many countries in Europe and Asia.

We primarily focus on:

- Decommissioning and dismantling services
- Radioactive waste management services
- Treatment of radioactive waste into SIAL matrix (Low, medium and high level)
- Reactor services (cleaning and monitoring of reactor vessel and primary circuit)
- Design, manufacture and delivery of decontamination equipment
- Design, manufacture and delivery of equipment for decommissioning and waste treatment
- Studies and analyzes for minimize of RAW and optimalization of RAW management services
- Radiation monitoring and inspections with ROV
- Decontamination services
- Free release measurement services

entityDescription:
Facilicom Solutions: Your Customized Facility Management Solution
Facility management is not part of your organization’s core business. Facilicom Solutions (FS), a leader in facility management, offers tailored solutions to meet your needs. From providing a Facility Manager to delivering a complete integrated facilities package, we ensure convenience by offering a single point of contact and one collective invoice.
Our unique value lies in combining a comprehensive portfolio of in-house services with expertise in purchasing, contracting, and facility management. Services include catering, cleaning, and reception, complemented by external services like building maintenance, pest control, and more. Qualified subcontractors ensure quality across all offerings.
Contract Options Tailored to Your Needs
- Facility Management: Whether you need temporary or long-term reinforcement, we provide interim or permanent Facility Managers equipped with the expertise to handle change processes and projects. Flexible management capacity is available for a minimum of 3 months.
- Managing Agent - dedicated agent, or team responsible for maintaining the existing service contract and scope, either directly with the client or through Facilicom's IFM platform. Their role includes ensuring compliance, overseeing service delivery, and managing any necessary adjustments to align with client expectations and contract agreements.
- Project Management:Our project managers handle relocations, process optimizations, service desk implementations, and tender supervision, ensuring collaboration with clients and users throughout.
- Consultancy: With practical experience, we advise on facility efficiency, cost analysis, policy, staff coaching, quality improvement, and more, guaranteeing successful implementation.
- Reception Services: As a top provider in Belgium, our hosts offer a professional, welcoming reception experience. They also manage service desks via Facilicom Information Tool - FIT (FMIS system), ensuring smooth ticket handling and issue resolution.
With Facilicom Solutions, you receive integrated services and expertise designed to optimize your facility management processes.
